subject: Marketplace listing: DataForge integration & co-sell evidence
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice@dataforge.com>, procurement@dataforge.com
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jul 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing: DataForge integration & co-sell evidence

Hi Alice / DataForge team,

Great to have the integration coming together — thanks for the demo last week. I wanted to pull together a single thread for the marketplace listing + co-sell asks so legal, product, and partner ops have everything in one place. High-level asks from our side: 

- Technical evidence: model endpoints, auth pattern, sample metering logs (we need a CSV showing API dimensions). See "meter-sample.csv" attached.
- Listing metadata: short description, supported regions, and compliance statements.
- Co-sell entitlements: proposed revenue share % and lead-handling flow. We generally require a defined lead routing playbook for the sell-with program.
- Contracting: if you can share the latest MSA redlines, we can route to legal; DocuSign link preferred for signatures.

Attached: evidence_binder.pdf (initial technical summary), meter-sample.csv. I also uploaded a starter folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DfG-DataForge-evidence

Can you confirm the metering dimension names (e.g., tokens_generated vs. requests) and whether trial SKUs need a separate entitlement? If you can respond by end of week we can target a canary listing in mid-August.

Thanks,
Rafael
Head of Partner GTM
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: evidence_binder.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)
Attachment: meter-sample.csv (CSV, 48KB)

From: Alice Park <alice@dataforge.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@dataforge.com, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jul 2024 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: DataForge integration & co-sell evidence

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the consolidated ask. Quick answers: 

- Metering: we currently surface two dimensions: `tokens` (per token processed) and `ingest_gb` (data processed). We exported a sample CSV (attached) showing both.
- Trial SKUs: yes, we prefer a separate trial entitlement so customers can spin up a sandbox instance without billing.
- Revenue share: our commercial prefers a 70/30 split (DataForge/Redwood) for resales, but we are open to a different split for managed co-sell opportunities — legal will redline the MSA.

I'll route the MSA redlines to your DocuSign link later today: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/ABC123

Next steps from our side: upload the integration manifest (we'll add a README for region support) and confirm the test accounts for canary.

Best,
Alice Park
Head of Partnerships
DataForge Inc.

--
Attachment: meter-sample.csv (CSV, 52KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Park <alice@dataforge.com>, procurement@dataforge.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2024 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: DataForge integration & co-sell evidence

Thanks Rafael / Alice — tagging in the listing + evidence checklist from partner-ops. Quick notes: 

1) Metering mapping: we need a canonical SKU->dimension mapping for our billing shim. Suggested mapping: `df.tokens` -> tokens (per 1k), `df.ingest` -> ingest_gb (per GB). Please confirm if DataForge units align. See attached meter-mapping.xlsx.

2) Certification/evidence: for GCP and AWS public listings we require the following artifacts in the evidence binder: SOC2 summary, automated integration tests (runbook + logs), and a short latency/throughput profile. If you don't have SOC2, please indicate timeline.

3) Co-sell ops: for managed opportunities we need an explicit lead-transfer URL and HubSpot pipeline stage. Please add HubSpot Deal ID when you create the deal (we can reference HS-234789 after you create it).

4) Contracting: legal flagged a standard revenue share clause for marketplace resale. If DataForge expects 70/30, legal will request carveouts for promotional credits and trial SKUs.

Action items: 
- DataForge: confirm meter unit names and upload SOC2 or a self-attestation.
- Rafael / Partner GTM: once DataForge confirms, I'll queue the listing intake and schedule a 30-min triage with engineering.

Thanks,
Olga
Director, Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: meter-mapping.xlsx (XLSX, 64KB)
Related: HubSpot record HS-234789

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Park <alice@dataforge.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2024 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: DataForge integration & co-sell evidence

Looping in engineering sync request — Rafael / Olga, can we do a 30-minute technical triage next week (options: Tue 16th 10am PT or Wed 17th 2pm PT)? Agenda: SKU/dimension mapping confirmation, listing metadata, and a minimal canary plan (1 region, 2 test customers). I'll book the slot once you confirm.

Also: Rafael, if DataForge signs off on the trial SKU carveout, we can publish the trial as a separate listing object rather than a hidden SKU — reduces confusion for sales.

Karthik
Sr. Product Manager, Marketplace Integrations
